items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Polly went everywhere. She really did. She amazed me.

ctx.x: Yeah, Polly. Polly went everywhere. She really did. She amazed me. She would go Monday nights to hear the big band at the Vanguard. She really had her – she loved all the guys. She went – we have a huge thing of, what?, drum sticks now, signed drum sticks. She loved the music, and she went everywhere. At that time it was – the 70s – where did you used to come down to? The Five Spot. Didn’t that move to Eighth Street at one point?
